summary: Frontend-only regression on NOVA Konut static site covering: cookie-banner removal, careers landing restructure, new separate job-detail page, applicant-privacy-notice, restructured Speak Up page, both non-transmitting forms, legal-page copy sweep, navigation, mobile responsiveness and console errors. All acceptance criteria in the review request PASSED. No fixes required.
verified_checks: index.html + careers.html + anonymous-reporting.html + privacy-notice.html: no cookie/consent banner visible after 5s wait; no GOT IT button; localStorage and sessionStorage empty on load.

Footer Cookie Notice link present; privacy-notice.html, cookie-notice.html, ethical-principles.html and applicant-privacy-notice.html contain no vendor names (Google Fonts / jsDelivr / GitHub / OpenStreetMap) and no 'is being verified'/'under review'/'will be updated once confirmed' wording.

careers.html title = 'Careers | NOVA Konut'; page contains only intro + Open positions with a single 'Construction Site Manager (Architect) — Kadıköy / Bağdat Caddesi, Istanbul — Full time · On site — VIEW DETAILS' listing; NO form / no requirements / no apply-by-email / no 'No other positions are open at present.'
vacancy-link-csm href = 'construction-site-manager-architect.html'; clicking triggers a full page navigation (URL becomes /construction-site-manager-architect.html, not a hash anchor).

Job-detail page contains role intro, Requirements list including the three required strings (University degree in Architecture, At least 10 years of active construction-site experience, Active driver with a valid Class B driving licence) and Responsibilities. None of the forbidden phrases present (şantiye şefi, 25 years, associate degree, military service, 'rather than direct the work from a distance').

Full application form visible with all data-testids present: careers-name/email/phone/city/position/years/experience/cv/privacy/privacy-link/submit. Position = 'Construction Site Manager (Architect)' and has the readonly attribute. Privacy link -> applicant-privacy-notice.html. Character counter shows '0 / 2,000 characters'. CV picker labelled PDF/DOC/DOCX up to 10 MB.
Empty submit produces an error summary with heading '8 FIELDS NEED YOUR ATTENTION' listing exactly 8 issues; ZERO network requests fired.
CV: choosing .txt shows exactly 'Please choose a PDF, DOC or DOCX file.'; choosing a valid PDF shows file name + size; Remove control resets label to 'No file selected'.

Valid submit: inline result is EXACTLY 'Online submission is temporarily unavailable. Your application has not been sent. Please apply by email.' All typed values (name, email, experience 175 chars) and chosen file remain; localStorage and sessionStorage stay empty ({}); no external/API network request fired; no success indicators such as 'Application received'/'Thank you'/'submitted successfully'.

Apply by Email CTA present with mailto href = mailto:iletisim@nova.istanbul?subject=Application%20%E2%80%94%20Construction%20Site%20Manager%20(Architect)%20%E2%80%94%20NOVA%20Konut, single instruction line rendered, applicant-privacy link visible.

applicant-privacy-notice.html loads directly with the standard NOVA legal-page design; contains 'NOVA KONUT İNŞAAT YATIRIM A.Ş.' and KEP 'novakonut@hs01.kep.tr'; does not use 'infrastructure is being verified', 'updated once the position is confirmed', or claim that ticking a box authorises all recruitment processing.

anonymous-reporting.html: 'Online submission is not yet active' box gone; no 'How to report now' section; concise structure present with visible report form. Empty submit shows '2 FIELDS NEED YOUR ATTENTION' listing category + description; ZERO requests. Filled submit produces EXACTLY 'Online reporting is temporarily unavailable. Your report has not been sent.'; description retained (228 chars); no storage writes; no tracking/reference code; no 'Report submitted' state. speakup-ethics-link -> ethical-principles.html.

Development-commentary sweep across careers.html, construction-site-manager-architect.html, anonymous-reporting.html, applicant-privacy-notice.html, privacy-notice.html, cookie-notice.html, ethical-principles.html and index.html: none of 'backend', 'connected later', 'not yet in operation', 'not yet active', 'not yet being received', 'is not saved', 'feature flag', 'will be connected' appears in rendered text.

Menu links on both new pages: menu-link-careers -> careers.html, menu-link-speakup -> anonymous-reporting.html. Footer links: footer-link-careers -> careers.html, footer-link-speakup -> anonymous-reporting.html, footer-link-getintouch -> index.html#register.

Responsive: horizontal overflow = 0 on desktop (1920) AND mobile (390x844) for careers.html, construction-site-manager-architect.html, anonymous-reporting.html, applicant-privacy-notice.html and index.html.
No console errors (severity=error) captured on any tested page, desktop or mobile.
